Execute Dual-Gated SaMD Clinical Chart Write-Back

Source: R/clinical-writeback.R
clinical_writeback_execute.Rd

Enforces both the server-wide SaMD feature flag (clinical_writeback_enabled()) and RBAC "clinical_writeback" permission (pi or admin) before dispatching or simulating STOW-RS and FHIR DiagnosticReport + Provenance write-back, logging every event to the SHA-256 hash-chained audit trail.

Usage

clinical_writeback_execute(
  ctx,
  principal,
  project_id,
  air_bundle,
  dicomweb_stow_url = NULL,
  fhir_base_url = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

ctx

A "dicom_server_context" from server_create_context().

principal

Authenticated "dicom_server_principal".

project_id

Project identifier.

air_bundle

A "dicom_ihe_air_bundle" from ihe_air_bundle().

dicomweb_stow_url

Optional DICOMweb STOW-RS endpoint URL.

fhir_base_url

Optional FHIR R4/R5 base URL for DiagnosticReport and Provenance write-back.

dry_run

Logical; if TRUE, validates gates and logs audit entry without performing external HTTP calls.

Value

A list with status, study_uid, dicom_sop_uid, and audit_seq.
